scripts.install:desktop: if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin" ]; then pkill -x Obails || true; rm -rf /Applications/Obails.app /Applications/Obails_new.app /Applications/Obails_old.app && cp -R bin/obails.app /Applications/Obails.app; fi
scripts.reinstall:desktop: pnpm run package:desktop && pnpm run install:desktop
